summary: News Corp filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) disclosing routine daily repurchase disclosures to the ASX under its existing $1 billion stock buyback program. No specific share amounts, prices, or timing are given beyond the ongoing authorization. The filing is procedural, providing ASX notices as exhibits and cautioning on forward-looking statements. This is not a special situation — it is a standard issuer update on an existing capital return plan, without any event that would classify it as a special corporate action.
